description: Metadata for public Internet Society pages about artificial intelligence and technology on www.internetsociety.org and internetsociety.org. internetsociety.org redirects to www. Each stored URL was confirmed with one bounded robots-allowed HTML GET that stayed on those hosts. A host that does not resolve, HTML or challenge robots.txt, a Cloudflare, cookie, or captcha challenge, an authentication wall, an HTTP error, a non-HTML body, a robots disallow, or an off-host redirect stores nothing. An empty catalog is valid. Rows keep title, publisher, canonical URL, publication date, and rights. Page text, abstracts, quotes, transcripts, PDFs, and chart data are not stored. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix. A sole restricted deed keeps its own token. A missing publication date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. uk_ogl requires the British phrase Open Government Licence. runner_wired stays false.
